subject: Post-demo: Deployment economics for OptiScale (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@optiscale.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@optiscale.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: Deployment economics for OptiScale (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps while it’s fresh:

Recap
- Main constraint: low-latency interactive inference for 100k monthly active users (peak 6k qps bursts for short windows).
- Data residency: US-only tenant; logs retained for 90 days (compliance team asked).
- Security: must pass a short SOC2 questionnaire and KMS for key management.

High-level deployment options we discussed
1) Hosted API — fastest to ship, no infra commitments, per-token pricing. Good for getting a PoC live within days but unit economics can be higher at sustained heavy volume.
2) Dedicated capacity — reserved GPU pools. Better per-token/economic unit at scale when you commit (monthly/annual). Predictable latency and isolation.
3) Private (VPC / on-prem) — for full control and stricter governance. Often higher up-front setup cost and long-term support contract.

Proposed next steps (please confirm):
- I’ll send a short cost model capturing: per-token hosted projection, 1yr/3yr reserved capacity math (commits + burst), and ballpark private deployment estimate.
- You share: a week of anonymized traffic profile (token distribution, peak window length) and any procurement timeline constraints.
- Schedule: recommend a 30-min follow-up after you review the model (I can do Thu or Fri).

Attaching a quick template of the 3-year commit worksheet and a one-pager for hosted vs dedicated. The worksheet contains rows for your traffic bands so we can toggle commit size.

If useful, we can also run a short 48-72 hour pilot on Dedicated to validate latency and tail behaviour before any commit.

Looking forward —
Vivek
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

- OptiScale_3yr_commit_model.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

Subject: Re: Post-demo: Deployment economics for OptiScale (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Thanks Vivek — that captures it well. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- Traffic: our product sends ~35M tokens/day on average today, but that’s expected to grow 3–4x next 12 months. Peak bursts are the concern — typically 4–8 minute spikes driven by batch job completions.
- Procurement: our procurement team needs a 3yr TCO and a clear exit/fallback plan if we downscale.
- Security: SOC2 is non-negotiable; we’ll need the questionnaire and an SLA addendum for latency.

We’ll share a scrubbed sample of traffic by EOD tomorrow. Thu morning is good for a follow-up call.

Jordan
VP Product, OptiScale
jordan.lee@optiscale.com

Subject: Follow-up: three-year commit worksheet + quick economic summary

Jordan / Priya —

Per our call, attaching the filled commit worksheet with two scenarios:
A) Conservative: 1.5x current tokens, modest efficiency gains — shows Dedicated break-even vs Hosted at ~14 months on a 3yr commit.
B) Aggressive: 3x growth + optimized batching — Dedicated pays back in ~8 months and materially lowers per-token spend.

Key assumptions (highlighted on tab "Assumptions"):
- Model mix: 70% medium, 30% large (we mapped to Redwood-Medium/Redwood-Large perf profiles).
- Tokenization: avg 1.9 tokens/user-interaction.
- Reserved SKU: 4x A100-equivalent nodes for steady baseline with burst pool for 2x demand.

Notes & asks
- Can you confirm whether logs retention must be >90 days; that changes storage cost in Private.
- Procurement: if legal needs example SLA language I can loop in our contracts lead.

I recommend we run a 72-hour Dedicated pilot sized to the conservative scenario to validate tail latency and infra autoscaling behaviour before a final commit. If you want, we’ll include an upfront credit toward the first month of a reserve if the pilot validates.

Will follow up to schedule Thu morning.

Best,
Vivek
